Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Ann Patrick (E035)
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Engineer (both notes agree)
- Employment type: contractor (both notes agree)
- Security training: basic (Security agent looked this up)

Policy for contractors:
- read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

She has basic training, not advanced. So maximum is read.

Requested admin > maximum read. So grant maximum = read. Never grant more than requested; read is less than admin so fine.

Decision: read.
